SELECT DISTINCT fiscal_year, fiscal_period, fiscal_period_label, period_end_date
FROM ref_fiscal_calendar
WHERE fiscal_period = 8
ORDER BY fiscal_year DESC
LIMIT 5

calls.statement:
SELECT 
  tier,
  COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) AS member_count
FROM dim_member
WHERE join_date <= '2025-12-21'
  AND valid_from <= '2025-12-21'
  AND valid_to >= '2025-12-21'
GROUP BY tier
ORDER BY tier

calls.statement:
SELECT 
  COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) AS total_active_members
FROM dim_member
WHERE join_date <= '2025-12-21'
  AND valid_from <= '2025-12-21'
  AND valid_to >= '2025-12-21'

SELECT 
  COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) AS members_joined_after_period,
  MAX(join_date) AS latest_join_date
FROM dim_member
WHERE join_date > '2025-12-21'
  AND valid_from <= '2025-12-21'
  AND valid_to >= '2025-12-21'

SELECT 
  member_id,
  join_date,
  tier,
  valid_from,
  valid_to,
  is_current
FROM dim_member
WHERE join_date <= '2025-12-21'
  AND valid_from <= '2025-12-21'
  AND valid_to >= '2025-12-21'
LIMIT 5

SELECT 
  tier,
  COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) AS active_members
FROM dim_member
WHERE join_date <= '2025-12-21'
  AND valid_from <= '2025-12-21'
  AND valid_to >= '2025-12-21'
GROUP BY tier
ORDER BY tier
